description: Subscriber removal action in directory, edge-to-edge popup advert live preview alignment, button placement position toggle, and dynamic clean URL directory fallbacks.
author: Conspodium Core Team
highlights: Added 1-click Subscriber Deletion action in the Subscriber Directory with confirmation dialog and live list refreshing
Aligned backend live popup advert preview with frontend design (edge-to-edge flyer presentation with floating circular close button)
Added Button Placement Position selector in popup settings: choose between Floating on Image (Overlay) or Below Image (Dedicated Bar)
Synchronized both frontend and backend popup renderers to honor button placement configuration dynamically
Added dynamic clean URL directory index fallback to automatically route any present and future subpages cleanly
Included root .htaccess in automated update packaging and in-app updater extraction for seamless 1-click deployment
